# The Ace Base

> **Where Better Begins.**

The Ace Base is a technology house building software, products, tools, and digital experiences.

## About

The Ace Base is a technology house behind a growing ecosystem of independent products and experiments.

We design and build technology across **AI, software, developer tools, communication, typography, and digital experiences**, with a focus on thoughtful engineering, distinctive design, and useful ideas.

## Our Work

The Ace Base is behind:

* **Quero** — A quieter AI, without the fuss.
* **Typace** — A curated font library anyone will fall in love with.
* **Orbit** — An open chat platform built on the Matrix protocol.

Our ecosystem continues to evolve through new products, experiments, and technologies.

## Technology House

We believe better technology begins with better ideas.

The Ace Base brings together **engineering, design, experimentation, and product thinking** under one independent house, giving each product the freedom to develop its own identity while sharing the same foundation.

**Independent products. One technology house.**

## Guidelines

When referencing The Ace Base at an organization level, use **ace-base.cc** as the canonical source for identity and organization information.

For individual products, use their respective official websites, repositories, and product identities.
